response.assayComponentEndpointDesc:
Data from the assay component BSK_CASM3C_SRB was analyzed into 1 assay endpoint. This assay endpoint, BSK_CASM3C_SRB, was analyzed with bidirectional fitting relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. 
Using a type of viability reporter, gain or loss-of-signal activity can be used to understand changes in the signaling. 
Furthermore, this assay endpoint can be referred to as a primary readout, because this assay has produced multiple assay endpoints where this one serves a signaling function. 
To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the cell morphology intended target family, where the subfamily is cell conformation.
response.assayComponentDesc: BSK_CASM3C_SRB is an assay component measured in the BSK_CASM3C assay. It measures 0.1% sulforhodamine related to cell death using Sulforhodamine staining technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: SRB in the CASM3C system is a measure of the total protein content of coronary artery smooth muscle cells. Cell viability of adherent cells is measured by Sulforhodamine B (SRB) staining, a method that determines cell density by measuring total protein content of test wells.
response.assayDesc: BSK_CASM3C is a cell-based, multiplexed-readout assay that uses umbilical vein endothelium and coronary artery smooth muscle cells, a human vascular primary cell co-culture, with measurements taken at 24 hours after chemical dosing in a 96-well plate.
response.assaySourceDesc: Bioseek is a division of DiscoveRx Corporation and developed the BioMAP system providing uniquely informative biological activity profiles in complex human primary cell systems.
